name: Toyotetsu America, Inc. (TTAI)
old_description: World Class Producer of Stamped and Welded Body Parts and Assemblies for the Automotive Industry
about:
Toyotetsu America, Inc. (TTAI) operates from Somerset, Kentucky, as part of Toyotetsu North America, a network that includes facilities in Owensboro, Kentucky; San Antonio, Texas; Simcoe, Ontario; and Guanajuato, Mexico. The company traces its roots back more than 25 years, establishing itself as a supplier of stamped and welded body components for the automotive sector.

TTAI specializes in metal stamping, welding, and assembly of body parts and structural assemblies for automotive manufacturers. Its production footprint spans multiple plants across North America, each equipped for high-volume stamping and robotic welding lines, though specific facility sizes and annual output figures are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves the automotive industry, providing components to original equipment manufacturers. Its customer base includes major automakers, though specific client names are not listed in the available information.

TTAI emphasizes lean manufacturing principles and operates state-of-the-art training centers at its locations to develop workforce skills. The company highlights its long tenure, employee-focused benefits, and job stability as factors that support consistent production quality.
